• Ethnic minority offenders were found to be given prison sentences at a statistically higher
rate for drug offences than white offenders (240% higher). However, “the study could not
account for the impact of aggravating and mitigating factors, or the possibility that BAME
offenders may have been convicted of more serious drugs offences that their White
counterparts.”
